# Save preceding the focused correction

[Español](README.es.md). `pending-v1.dat` was generated by running the original
4D-3e5b delivery before changing its behavior. It contains a
`historical-recovery-v1` plan, A → B → C, with an already prepared local pending
opportunity and no new transmitter/emission metadata. Stage two had no opportunity.

This is a test fixture, not installed content or a user's save.
`tests/recovery_provenance_smoke.py` verifies loading without rewriting, one capture
of the prepared opportunity and rejection of a manufactured second emission.
The report JSON preserves reproduction evidence and this file's SHA-256.
